name: Snowglobe
author: Saman Shirdel
description: Interactive, window-aware snowfall that settles on window tops and the ground, with a persistent snowman builder

barWidget.description: Snowfall on your desktop, snow on your windows

schema.label: Snowfall
schema.description: Map a click-through snow surface on every monitor

schema.label: Draw layer
schema.description: Above windows draws snow in front of them (recommended); behind keeps it under every window

schema.label: Snowplough
schema.description: Let a small snowplough clear the ground snow when it piles up

schema.label: Adaptive quality
schema.description: Reduce particle density automatically if a frame budget is exceeded

schema.label: Pause on fullscreen
schema.description: Stop the simulation on monitors with a fullscreen window

schema.label: Black-screen guard
schema.description: Do not draw the overlay when the compositor cannot give it a transparent surface (it would cover the desktop in black)
